text:
alex_dev: quick thread — thinking about adding header-based routing in gateway to route by X-Redwood-Auth-Context or User-Agent for model/cluster selection. sketch below, want opinions on security/telemetry/console UX.

sam_platform: can you paste a minimal example of rule format?

alex_dev: sure, prototype rule:

```json
{
  "match": {
    "headers": {"User-Agent": "^redwood-cli/.*", "X-Redwood-Role": "edge"}
  },
  "route": "dedicated-pool-edge",
  "priority": 100
}
```

maria_sre: worried about trusting forwarded headers. if we allow arbitrary User-Agent match, clients can spoof and get into special pool. need gateway to assert identity (mTLS) or require signed headers. :warning:

rachel_prod: agree. also need to think telemetry — how do we tag traces? prefer gateway emit attributes instead of passing auth context downstream.

kevin_infra: options: 1) gateway strips/rewrites incoming headers and injects signed `X-Internal-Auth` with HMAC. 2) gateway passes opaque token and services call profile API to resolve claims. HMAC gives lower latency but operational complexity.

alex_dev: HMAC idea seems reasonable. example header: `X-Redwood-Verified: hmac=...;v=1` The validation secret would be shared with backend pool nodes.

maria_sre: secrets on many nodes increases blast radius. prefer short-lived signed JWT issued by gateway with audience set to target service.

sam_platform: for console UX — operators need easy rule testing (simulate headers) and rollout percent. propose add a "simulate request" box and canary slider in rules editor.

rachel_prod: add metrics: route_matches, spoof_attempts, fallback_count. dashboards should show top header-values that hit a route.

gateway-bot: deploy check — existing config schema change detected, run `gw-config-lint`.

alex_dev: thanks. follow-ups: (1) add JWT-by-gateway path as default; (2) implement signed header option for low-latency trusted networks; (3) console: simulate + canary slider; (4) telemetry: gateway emits attributes and increments route_match metric; backends should ignore client-provided `X-Redwood-*` unless signed.

maria_sre: sounds good. one more: threat model doc before rollout. I'll draft a short one.

sam_platform: I'll wire up the console mockups. assigning to @alex_dev for prototype.

alex_dev: on it, ping me if you want to pair. :thumbsup:
